verdict.rationale:
Letta clearly supports persisting memories across sessions/conversations (stateful agents, /remember, memory blocks, cross-machine resume via docs-6/7/24/26), but semantic search over that memory is explicitly an optional add-on ('install the MemFS Search mod' for semantic/hybrid search), not a built-in default retrieval mechanism (letta-docs-28/41). Community discussion also raises open questions about memory scaling and quality over time (letta-comm-8, letta-comm-9), though Letta staff push back with transparency claims (letta-comm-10, letta-comm-11) rather than a concrete documented failure.
missing for 10: native out-of-the-box semantic search (not requiring a separate mod install), and independent hands-on evidence of retrieval quality/accuracy.
